honesty: Every name, role, zone and citation is read from the worldforge cards, the swarm, the advisor records and the hive registry; nothing is invented.

Audio: every row stores only the expected path (worldforge/out/voices/<world>/<last path segment of avatarId>.mp4); whether that file exists is never stored, because it changes as lines are rendered. Viewers HEAD-check it at runtime. This generator renders no audio.

Omega rows also point at the hive line audio (voice.audio.greet, ...); worldforge/voice/voice_intros.py does not render omega rows, so an omega viewer should try voice.audio.greet when the contract path is absent.

Advisors (Host Advisor, Steward Liaison, Alignment Advisor; 3 per world) are scripted guides under agents/advisors/<slug>.json: not AI models and not people. By the advisor contract they get no persona prompt (persona_prompt_id null, no metaprompt binding); their intro is built only from the record's name and manages.

Every Omega Steward is defined, not seated. No avatar holds governance.final_vote, charter.amend, treasury.transfer, proposal.enact, windfall.distribute or steward.appoint; those are held for the 2-of-3 Steward Council.

Coordinator rows link their WorldForge coordinator card (coordinator:<slug>) and take position from its volum; worlds[i].coordinator mirrors the row for worldforge/viewer.html, with facing derived from the plaza and card centres.

Zone strings carry zone_from. The Omega zone is the council card's name (the spec's own Steward Council zone, folded into that card by worldforge/build.mjs); the Omega card stands outside the council card (edge_gap_m in zone_from) and is never parented to it or a seat.
Avatar models are referenced by role (worldforge/out/assets/avatars/<role>.glb) and built elsewhere; this registry does not build or check the GLB files.
No model runs the persona prompts; they are reviewable text with a test suite.

audio_contract.stored: the expected path only, at rows[].audio (and worlds[i].coordinator.audio); never a voiced or exists flag
audio_contract.view_time: viewers HEAD-check rows[].audio; if absent they fall back to a labelled browser voice (voice.browser_fallback); omega rows may also use voice.audio.greet
audio_contract.held_by: audio_path_contract (paths unique per world; no status/voiced/exists keys in any row)

voice_pool.from: agents/hive.mjs ENGLISH_VOICES (read as text; the hive runs its main on import)
voice_pool.pick: specialist, coordinator and advisor: h = fnv1a(avatarId); id = pool[h % pool.length]; speed, browser pitch and lang from h by the tables agents/hive.mjs applies to Omegas (the hive hashes the world slug); omega: the hive voice

view_time.audio: rows[].audio exists (HTTP HEAD at view time); never stored here

viewer_contract.coordinator: worlds[i].coordinator: the coordinator row mirrored for worldforge/viewer.html; volum.center and volum.halfExtents are the coordinator card's, as [x, y, z] arrays in metres (world frame, Y up); facing is a unit [x, 0, z] vector from the plaza centre to the card centre; intro/voice/binding/permissions/audio as in rows[]; reserved_for_humans from the coordinator card; held by coordinator_viewer_entry
viewer_contract.specialists_advisors_and_omega: rows[] by cardId (the viewer places them from their cards)
